mapper.select: select t2.groupId as labelDictCode1, t2.groupName as labelNameLevel1, t2.groupValue as labelCodeLevel1, t3.groupId as labelDictCode2, t3.groupName as labelNameLevel2, t3.groupValue as labelCodeLevel2, t4.groupId as labelDictCode3, t4.groupName as labelNameLevel3, t4.groupValue as labelCodeLevel3, t5.groupId as labelDictCode4, t5.groupName as labelNameLevel4, t5.groupValue as labelCodeLevel4 FROM knowledge_base_group t1 LEFT JOIN knowledge_base_group t2 ON t1.groupId = t2.parentGroupId and t2.groupName != '全部' LEFT JOIN knowledge_base_group t3 ON t2.groupId = t3.parentGroupId and t3.groupName != '全部' LEFT JOIN knowledge_base_group t4 ON t3.groupId = t4.parentGroupId and t4.groupName != '全部' LEFT JOIN knowledge_base_group t5 ON t4.groupId = t5.parentGroupId and t5.groupName != '全部' where t1.parentGroupId = '0' and t1.groupName != '全部'

select concat_ws('-', kbgk6.groupValue, kbgk5.groupValue, kbgk4.groupValue, kbgk3.groupValue, kbgk2.groupValue, kbgk1.groupValue) from knowledge_base_group kbgk1 left join knowledge_base_group kbgk2 on kbgk1.parentGroupId = kbgk2.groupId and kbgk2.parentGroupId != '0' left join knowledge_base_group kbgk3 on kbgk2.parentGroupId = kbgk3.groupId and kbgk3.parentGroupId != '0' left join knowledge_base_group kbgk4 on kbgk3.parentGroupId = kbgk4.groupId and kbgk4.parentGroupId != '0' left join knowledge_base_group kbgk5 on kbgk4.parentGroupId = kbgk5.groupId and kbgk5.parentGroupId != '0' left join knowledge_base_group kbgk6 on kbgk5.parentGroupId = kbgk6.groupId and kbgk6.parentGroupId != '0' where kbgk1.parentGroupId != '0' and kbgk1.groupId = #{groupId};

select concat_ws('-', kbgk6.groupName, kbgk5.groupName, kbgk4.groupName, kbgk3.groupName, kbgk2.groupName, kbgk1.groupName) from knowledge_base_group kbgk1 left join knowledge_base_group kbgk2 on kbgk1.parentGroupId = kbgk2.groupId and kbgk2.parentGroupId != '0' left join knowledge_base_group kbgk3 on kbgk2.parentGroupId = kbgk3.groupId and kbgk3.parentGroupId != '0' left join knowledge_base_group kbgk4 on kbgk3.parentGroupId = kbgk4.groupId and kbgk4.parentGroupId != '0' left join knowledge_base_group kbgk5 on kbgk4.parentGroupId = kbgk5.groupId and kbgk5.parentGroupId != '0' left join knowledge_base_group kbgk6 on kbgk5.parentGroupId = kbgk6.groupId and kbgk6.parentGroupId != '0' where kbgk1.parentGroupId != '0' and kbgk1.groupId = #{groupId}

select concat_ws('-', kbgk6.groupValue, kbgk5.groupValue, kbgk4.groupValue, kbgk3.groupValue, kbgk2.groupValue, kbgk1.groupValue) as knowledgeCode, concat_ws('-', kbgk6.groupName, kbgk5.groupName, kbgk4.groupName, kbgk3.groupName, kbgk2.groupName, kbgk1.groupName) as knowledgeName from knowledge_base_group kbgk1 left join knowledge_base_group kbgk2 on kbgk1.parentGroupId = kbgk2.groupId and kbgk2.parentGroupId != '0' left join knowledge_base_group kbgk3 on kbgk2.parentGroupId = kbgk3.groupId and kbgk3.parentGroupId != '0' left join knowledge_base_group kbgk4 on kbgk3.parentGroupId = kbgk4.groupId and kbgk4.parentGroupId != '0' left join knowledge_base_group kbgk5 on kbgk4.parentGroupId = kbgk5.groupId and kbgk5.parentGroupId != '0' left join knowledge_base_group kbgk6 on kbgk5.parentGroupId = kbgk6.groupId and kbgk6.parentGroupId != '0' where kbgk1.parentGroupId != '0' and kbgk1.groupId = #{groupId}

select concat_ws('-', kbgk6.groupId, kbgk5.groupId, kbgk4.groupId, kbgk3.groupId, kbgk2.groupId, kbgk1.groupId) moduleCode from knowledge_base_group kbgk1 left join knowledge_base_group kbgk2 on kbgk1.parentGroupId = kbgk2.groupId and kbgk2.parentGroupId != '0' left join knowledge_base_group kbgk3 on kbgk2.parentGroupId = kbgk3.groupId and kbgk3.parentGroupId != '0' left join knowledge_base_group kbgk4 on kbgk3.parentGroupId = kbgk4.groupId and kbgk4.parentGroupId != '0' left join knowledge_base_group kbgk5 on kbgk4.parentGroupId = kbgk5.groupId and kbgk5.parentGroupId != '0' left join knowledge_base_group kbgk6 on kbgk5.parentGroupId = kbgk6.groupId and kbgk6.parentGroupId != '0' where kbgk1.parentGroupId != '0' and kbgk1.groupId = #{groupId};
select groupId,groupName,groupValue from knowledge_base_group where parentGroupId in (select groupId from knowledge_base_group where parentGroupId = 0) order by parentGroupId
